clarkson._notes: News listing shows ~3 items, no categories. Canonical majors page (clarkson.edu/academics/majors-minors) is JS-driven with no server-side list; transfer page used instead. Org chart renders person IDs + titles only, no names.

st-lawrence._notes: News listing is dated + categorized — best-structured source of the four. Do NOT rely on browser outlink resolution for article URLs; parse hrefs from raw HTML and match on title+date. Org chart overview is public and updates 2x/year (fall/spring); detailed chart is login-walled.

suny-canton._notes: News index shows featured items only; the year archive (/news/2026/) carries the full list. The index 'View news archive' link points elsewhere — use the explicit year URL and roll it yearly. Org-chart page is image-only; leadership tracked via about/college.html leadership section.

suny-potsdam._notes: No public org chart; leadership baseline compiled from president's office page + news (see baseline JSON caveats). Programs URL serves the 2022-2023 ARCHIVED catalog — locate the current catalog URL when possible. News index is featured-only; paginated dated listing exists (/news?page=N).
